description: Maps every benchmark spec (benchmarks/specs/<tier>/<id>.md) to a local code-level verification surface. A spec is 'covered' when its `code_level_target` exists and runs green under pytest. Uncovered specs are honestly marked `pending` — the aggregate code_level score ONLY counts covered specs + a separate coverage ratio reports how many of the 20 specs have code-level surfaces.

baseline/01_crud_todos.acceptance_coverage_notes: covers owner-scope 404-not-403, keyset stability under concurrent other-owner inserts, owner-only listing

baseline/02_auth_only_saas.acceptance_coverage_notes: covers hash+verify roundtrip, logout revocation, single-use reset tokens, login rate limit per-email/per-ip, constant-time unknown-email path

baseline/03_webhook_sink.acceptance_coverage_notes: covers HMAC signature check, ±5min timestamp window, exactly-once on 10 parallel duplicates

baseline/05_multi_tenant_admin.acceptance_coverage_notes: covers cross-tenant 404 (not 403), impersonation records real user, tenant-purge leaves zero rows, audit hash-chain tamper detection

mid/01_saas_with_stripe_billing.acceptance_coverage_notes: covers duplicate-event dedup, bad-signature 401, plan change via webhook, idempotent grace job, cancel-at-period-end
